candidate_observations.reading: Global exclusion and a synchronous verifier avoided both compared safety exposures, but serialized verification produced the lowest throughput and largest verification backlog.

Independent shard verifiers produced the highest accepted throughput; local-only first-pass exclusion admitted three cross-shard collisions that fencing and recovery coordination rejected before acceptance.
Optimistic workers and replay preserved accepted results, but the asynchronous reducer accumulated 105 task-ticks of unverified exposure and did not exceed shard throughput.

falsifiable_hypothesis: At least three independently reasoned repository-factory architectures expose materially different safety/throughput trade-offs under one frozen simulation.

post_result_directional_correction.observed: lease-shards was fastest at 1.333333 accepted tasks/tick; event-log was second at 1.2
post_result_directional_correction.preregistered_prediction: event-log predicted highest throughput when its materializer kept pace

scope: SUPPORTED only for trade-off exposure under PO03-WA-017-FROZEN-SIM-001; no production architecture selection or general benchmark claim.
